title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 10
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: thư viện, khách sạn, phòng tranh, đại lý ô tô, vườn bách thảo, bảo tàng khoa học, nhà hát trùng tu, ứng dụng so sánh giá, giờ làm linh hoạt, studio ảnh, đi chung xe, phần mềm quản lý dự án; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

Our volunteers play an important role in helping visitors learn about the region's history of shipbuilding and fishing. We are currently looking for volunteers for the following roles:

Riverside Theater Reopens After Restoration

RIVERSIDE (April 20) – After two years of restoration work, the historic Riverside Theater will reopen to the public next month. – [1] – The 1,100-seat theater, which first opened in 1928, had been closed since 2022 because of damage to its roof and heating system.

The $12 million project restored the theater's painted ceiling and original chandeliers. – [2] – New seats, a modern sound system, and an elevator were also installed, making the building fully accessible for the first time.

The theater will be managed by the nonprofit Riverside Arts Council, which plans to host concerts, films, and community events. – [3] – The first performance, on May 17, will feature the Riverside Symphony Orchestra.

Tickets for the opening concert go on sale on May 1 at the theater's box office. – [4] –

www.dinerspeak.com – Review of Olive & Thyme Bistro
Reviewer: Martin Cole
Rating: 3 out of 5 stars
Date: February 18

I had dinner at Olive & Thyme last Saturday with three friends to celebrate a birthday. The food was excellent, especially the lamb stew and the lemon tart. However, the service was very slow. We waited almost 40 minutes for our main dishes, and our server seemed to forget about us. Also, although I had requested a table by the window when I booked, we were seated next to the kitchen door. I would go back for the food, but I hope the service improves.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Response from the owner – February 20

Dear Mr. Cole,

Thank you for your review. I'm glad you enjoyed the lamb stew, which is our head chef's own recipe. Please accept my apologies for the slow service. That evening, two of our servers were sick, and we did not have enough staff for a fully booked dining room. We have since hired three additional servers.

I'm also sorry that your seating request was not met. We have updated our reservation system so that such requests are clearly displayed to our hosts.

I would like to invite you and your friends back for a complimentary dessert. Please show this message to your server on your next visit.

Sincerely,
Anita Rossi
Owner, Olive & Thyme Bistro

Starting in September, Hartley Industries employees who share rides to work will receive special benefits. Employees who carpool at least three days a week will get a reserved parking space near the main entrance and a monthly gas card worth $40.
